info.title: EncBird Agent Learning API
info.description: Public HTTP contract for the EncBird learning plugin. Caller identity comes from bearer access tokens. Learning evidence and privacy requirements apply to submitted data.

get.summary: Read stored learning level without private profile fields.
List saved expressions; coverage and clipping are explicit.

post.summary: Request expression registration; obtain explicit payment approval if returned.
post.description: A request without approval may return approval_required. Approval-bearing execution requires write permission; preserve the same idempotencyKey when approving or retrying. Never infer approval.

get.summary: Search saved phrases and Korean meanings.
List selected questions and phrase associations; listing is not completion.

post.summary: Save actual answer, learner rating 1-4 and assistance for a pinned question revision.
Save permitted host messages and evidence-grounded learning facts.

phraseOrigin.description: user_expression: expression actually used by the learner; quoted_expression: expression quoted in an actual learner message; host_generated: host-created wording based on learner intent. The first two must occur in a referenced role=user message.

post.description: phraseOrigin is required. user_expression and quoted_expression must appear in the actual user messages named by evidenceIds. host_generated identifies host-created wording based on evidenced learner intent. No vocabulary registration or credit charge occurs.

post.summary: Revoke a previous connection resource under the current valid bearer account.
post.description: Client OAuth recovery endpoint, not an MCP tool. A current unexpired bearer supplies all authority. Only previous connections belonging to the currently authenticated account can be revoked. The client must first verify fresh ID-token sub equals the persisted previous subject. connectionId is a 64-hex resource selector, never authority. Historical JWTs are not accepted in the HTTP payload or as authentication. No active connection or profile is required. A new unregistered current grant is allowed, but a revoked current family returns CONNECTION_INACTIVE and must be replaced by explicit same-account browser login, not refresh.

connectionId.description: Canonical lowercase 64-hex previous connection resource ID; the server normalizes hexadecimal input. A missing stored ID may be derived locally from stored clientId and decoded old origin_jti strictly as a resource selector.

403.description: PERMISSION_REQUIRED for insufficient current scope, or CONNECTION_INACTIVE for a revoked current family.

post.summary: Acknowledge an already registered NORMAL expression and close its version-pinned recommendation without charging.
post.description: A separate zero-charge acknowledgement requiring existing NORMAL vocabulary and the original selected phraseHash/version. Preserve registrationKey from the successful registration attempt. An immutable receipt maps InputPhrase to VocabularyID for corrected spelling. If no receipt exists after an already-owned preview, NORMAL vocabulary must have the candidate hash itself. On failure the dictionary registration remains complete: retry acceptance with the exact same payload, without charging or generating again.

version.description: Exact selected candidate version. Explicit zero is allowed for an unchanged legacy candidate.

registrationKey.description: Exact key from the successful registration attempt (its original idempotencyKey); 1–128 printable ASCII bytes 0x21–0x7e, with no whitespace. Current AddExpressionResult does not echo the key.

bearerAuth.description: Cognito access token: matching client/resource, origin_jti, resource/learning.read; writes additionally resource/learning.write.
